title: AgentSwitchboard reversible system bootstrap lifecycle

inspect: must distinguish ASB-owned state from merely-present external state
must report whether Remove is currently safe from recorded ownership plus observed drift
apply: must ascertain prerequisites before owned machine mutation
must persist original before-state before the first reversible machine mutation
must update durable state as each mutation becomes ASB-owned
must preserve an original pre-ASB baseline across idempotent Apply or upgrade
must verify final state before marking lifecycle status installed
remove: must require durable ownership evidence before reversing a present resource
must validate every owned resource for drift before the first destructive rollback mutation
must reverse only deltas explicitly recorded as ASB-owned
must restore preexisting resources from verified backups or property-level snapshots
must preserve unrelated configuration, files, PATH entries, credentials, and user state
must fail closed when a current owned surface no longer matches the recorded post-Apply state
must verify rollback before marking lifecycle status removed
must be idempotent after a completed Remove

dedicatedFile.install: record existed-before, before hash, changed-by-ASB, after hash, and backup path when replacement occurs
dedicatedFile.remove: delete only a file created by ASB or restore a verified preexisting backup; current file hash must match recorded ASB post-state before mutation

dedicatedDirectory.remove: remove the directory only when ASB created it and it is empty after owned files are removed

machinePathEntry.install: record whether the exact normalized entry preexisted and whether ASB added it
machinePathEntry.remove: remove only exact entries recorded as addedByAsb; never normalize away unrelated entries

sharedJsonConfig.install: record property presence/value before ASB mutation and which exact properties ASB changed
sharedJsonConfig.remove: three-way/property-level rollback only; preserve unrelated properties and fail closed if an ASB-owned property drifted after Apply

sharedMachineRoot.install: every adapter owns an adapter-specific subdirectory; shared roots are never recursively deleted by an adapter
sharedMachineRoot.remove: adapter may remove its own empty subdirectory only; shared AgentSwitchboard roots remain

failureRules.partialApplyOrRemove: preserve durable intermediate state for recovery; never pretend absent/removed

forbidden: blind recursive deletion outside an adapter-owned canonical root
deleting a resource solely because its path resembles an ASB-managed path
removing PATH entries that predated ASB ownership
restoring an entire shared config file over unrelated later edits
deleting provider credentials, user settings, sessions, project state, or caches unless a separate explicit contract owns them
claiming uninstall success without rollback verification
using a user-local receipt as the sole authority for machine-wide deletion
proofCeiling: This contract defines reversible ownership and rollback semantics. Each adapter must still prove its own resource-specific Apply/Remove behavior and physical machine execution.
